I am 68, my man and me are the only ones here. The children are in Shijiazhuang, they send money sometimes. 15.5 mu is too much for these old bones but I can't leave the land. My nephew comes to help when it is busy.

I do what I did last year. Why change? Old Wang across the path, his cabbages were big last autumn, and I did the same as him so mine were good too. About 4000 kilo per mu, maybe more.

**Chinese cabbage** (大白菜) — my main crop, I put 6 mu in autumn like always. I use 2 bags of that 15-15-15 compound per mu before I transplant, then when the heads start to wrap I put 1 bag of urea per mu. Some years the worms eat the leaves bad, so I spray maybe 4 or 5 times. The agro-shop man tells me which bottle to use. I water from the well about 6 times, cabbage is thirsty.

**Spring cabbage** (甘蓝) — 3 mu in spring. Less fertilizer than big cabbage, it's a smaller crop. 1 and a half bags compound, half a bag urea. Spray 3-4 times.

**Chili** — 2 mu. Chili needs a lot of food because it grows all summer long. 3 bags compound, 1 bag urea. Spray often, the bugs love chili. 5 or 6 times. Water 6 times.

**Cotton** — 2 mu. Habit from when I was young. Cotton price is not good now so I don't waste money on it. 1 bag compound, half bag urea. 3 sprays.

**Maize** — 2.5 mu summer maize. 2 bags compound at planting, 1 bag urea when the tassel comes. Spray once or twice for the borer.

I buy seed from the same dealer in town, he gives me the improved kinds — hybrid maize, good cabbage seed. For cotton I still use the seed I saved, it's enough.

The man with the rotary tractor comes and does all my fields, 40 yuan per mu. My back cannot plough anymore.

I always put a little more fertilizer than needed. If the harvest is bad we have nothing to eat. Wasting some fertilizer is just losing a few yuan — losing the harvest is losing everything.
